newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish bonds in tight ranges, await U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Finnish bonds in tight ranges, await U.S. data.

text.p: Finnish bonds were trapped in narrow ranges amid thin trading on Tuesday as the market held its breath ahead of key data from the U.S., dealers said.
Even a credit upgrade from European agency IBCA failed to boost the lethargic market, they said.
IBCA raised Finland's long-term foreign currency rating to AA plus from AA, while its local currency ratings were affirmed.
"This was to be expected as other key agencies have already raised their ratings," one dealer said.
T-bill auction raised a modest 495 million markka as investors were reluctant to take up positions, dealers said.
The markka was softer against the mark, taking its cue from the weakening Swedish crown, forex dealers said.
Firm resistance for DEM/FIM was seen at 3.02 and support at 3.00.
The markka traded at record lows against the bullish dollar.
